# Data & Account Deletion — PlayBox

Last updated: 12 June 2026

This page explains how to request deletion of your data and, where applicable, your account in the PlayBox app (`org.infinitespaces.playbox`, on Google Play and the Apple App Store), operated by Infinite Spaces. It accompanies our [Privacy Policy](/playbox-privacy).

## How to request deletion

Email [contact@infinitespaces.org](mailto:contact@infinitespaces.org) from the contact address associated with your use of PlayBox, with the subject line **"Data deletion request"**. If you created an account, include the email or phone number on that account so we can locate it. We also honour deletion requests submitted through the Google Play data-deletion link. The email route above serves App Store users equally — no store account is required to make a request.

## What we delete

- Any account information you provided (name, email address, phone number) if you created an account.
- The link between your anonymous PlayBox identifier and any contact information, mementos, or session history tied to you.

## What we may retain, and why

- **Accounting and transaction records.** We retain a minimal, de-identified record of purchases (amount, date, resulting credit/entry) for as long as required for tax, accounting, and fraud-prevention obligations. These records are not linked back to your contact information after deletion.
- **Card data.** PlayBox never stores your card number; card-data retention is governed by **Stripe**, our payment processor.
- **Anonymous records.** If you never created an account, your anonymous record is automatically anonymised 90 days after it is created.

## How long it takes

We acknowledge deletion requests within a few business days and complete eligible deletions within 30 days, subject to the retention exceptions above.

## Contact

Questions or deletion requests: [contact@infinitespaces.org](mailto:contact@infinitespaces.org).
